excerpt.zh: 全船各层甲板已通报发生一起模拟的安全事件。乘客们被招募参与一场全船范围的调查游戏，以找出安插在船员中的“外来特工”。
excerpt.en: A staged security breach has been announced across all decks. Passengers are recruited to identify planted 'foreign agents' among the crew in a ship-wide investigation game.
